notes:
### Product Overview
Monday.com is a customizable work operating system (Work OS) and project management platform that enables teams to plan, track, and manage workflows, projects, and everyday tasks in a centralized workspace.
* **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference
* **Verbatim Quote:** "...connect to your monday data with the platform api an expressive api to interact with your workflows, automate processes, power integrations, and more!"

---

### Authentication Methods & Primary Auth
The Monday.com platform API supports two main authentication methods:
1. **Personal API Tokens:** Static tokens unique to individual user accounts, used primarily for direct API access or testing. They are passed in the `Authorization` header without a `Bearer` prefix.
2. **OAuth 2.0 / 2.1:** Used for apps and multi-tenant integrations to handle redirect flows, token exchange, refresh tokens, and user consent. These tokens require a `Bearer` prefix in the `Authorization` header.

For a multi-tenant integration platform like Composio, **OAuth 2.0** (`oauth2`) is the primary authentication method.
* **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/oauth (via stitchflow.com / growthmethod.com)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Authentication uses either a personal API token (no `Bearer` prefix in the Authorization header) or an OAuth 2.0 access token (`Bearer` prefix required)."

---

### Developer Credentials & Cost
* **Access Tier:** `self_serve_free`
* **How to get credentials:** Developers can sign up for a free, non-expiring developer account. Once registered, they can access the Developer Center to copy their personal API token or create a new application to obtain OAuth 2.0 credentials (`client_id` and `client_secret`).
* **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference
* **Verbatim Quote:** "...create your developer account if you don't have a monday.com account or simply want to have playground where you can start playing around with our developer tools such as the api and apps framework on a free, no expiration date developer account!"
* **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference (via monday.com Developer Center docs)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "In your monday.com account, click on your profile picture in the top right corner. Select Developers. This will open the Developer Center in another tab. Click API token > Show."

---

### API Style, Breadth, OpenAPI Spec, Webhooks, Sandbox
* **API Style:** GraphQL. The platform uses a single GraphQL endpoint (`POST https://api.monday.com/v2`) rather than REST-style resource URLs.
  * **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "graphql get everything you need in one api call use graphql's nested querying capabilities to get all the data you need in one shot."
* **API Breadth:** Broad coverage across multiple products (Work Management, CRM, Dev, Service) to read and modify boards, items, columns, leads, docs, updates, and workspaces.
  * **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "multiple products, one api broad platform coverage to read and modify boards, leads, docs, updates, and much more."
* **OpenAPI Spec:** None. Because it is a strictly GraphQL-first API, it exposes a GraphQL schema and an interactive playground rather than a standard REST OpenAPI specification.
  * **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference (via breakcold.com)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "Monday's API at api.monday.com/v2 is the only GraphQL-first option on this list."
* **Webhooks:** Supported. Monday.com provides webhooks for both board-level events (e.g., item creation, column changes) and app lifecycle events (e.g., installations, subscriptions).
  * **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/plans-and-pricing (via monday.com app docs)
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "Webhooks are automated requests sent from monday.com containing event data whenever an app lifecycle event occurs in your app."
* **Sandbox:** While there is no isolated, dedicated sandbox environment, Monday.com provides a free, non-expiring developer account that acts as a playground for testing.
  * **Source URL:** https://developer.monday.com/api-reference
  * **Verbatim Quote:** "...simply want to have playground where you can start playing around with our developer tools such as the api and apps framework on a free, no expiration date developer account!"

---

### Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers
* **MCP Status:** `official`
* **Details:** Monday.com provides an official hosted MCP server (`mcp.monday.com/mcp`) pre-installed on every account, allowing AI clients to connect directly via OAuth or personal tokens. Additionally, the Monday.com AI team maintains an official open-source npm package (`@mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp`) that can be run locally or self-hosted.
* **Source URL:** https://github.com/mondaycom/mcp (via growthmethod.com)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "Monday.com's official MCP server is hosted at mcp.monday.com/mcp, pre-installed on every monday.com account, and authenticates through OAuth 2.0 or a bearer token with a personal API token."
* **Source URL:** https://github.com/mondaycom/mcp (via mcpservers.org)
* **Verbatim Quote:** "The @mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp package provides a plug-and-play server implementation for the Model Context Protocol (MCP)."

---

### Buildability Verdict
* **Verdict:** `ready_now`
* **Main Blocker:** None. The platform provides comprehensive public documentation, free self-serve developer accounts, standard OAuth 2.0 support, and an official, fully maintained MCP server framework. The only minor architectural consideration is that it is a GraphQL API, meaning tool builders must structure GraphQL queries/mutations rather than standard REST endpoints.
